evidence.decision: Establishes within-container move, cross-container copy and mandatory interapp copy before feedback; extracts the richest relevant representation.
evidence.artifact: Delivers source-operation-target, representation, selection and reversal contracts with the requested transfer artifact.
evidence.transformation: Contact-to-recipient drop copies only email rather than moving the source contact or importing irrelevant record data.
evidence.verification: Exercises reject/cancel, late Option release, slow/failing transfer and selection; source loss, false success and gesture-only transfer fail.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies Mac Option/background-window behavior, iPad gathering, visionOS user activities and TV/Watch exclusion; native gestures need runtime proof.
evidence.handoffs: Loads Undo and redo, File management or Accessibility according to transfer reversal, document integration or alternative-input needs.
evidence.distinctiveness: Representation negotiation and operation/selection semantics materially distinguish dragging from ordinary activation.
